parts.name: Question 1: Long Essay–Comparison
parts.quote: Question 1: Long Essay–Comparison will ask you to compare a required work of art and another of your choosing and explain the significance of the similarities and differences.

parts.name: Question 2: Long Essay–Visual/Contextual Analysis
parts.quote: Question 2: Long Essay–Visual/Contextual Analysis will ask you to select and identify a work of art and make assertions about it based on evidence.

parts.name: Question 3: Short Essay–Visual Analysis
parts.quote: Question 3: Short Essay–Visual Analysis will ask you to describe a work of art beyond the image set and connect it to an artistic tradition, style, or practice.

parts.name: Question 4: Short Essay–Contextual Analysis
parts.quote: Question 4: Short Essay–Contextual Analysis will ask you to describe contextual influences of a work of art in the image set and explain how context can influence artistic decisions.

parts.name: Question 5: Short Essay–Attribution
parts.quote: Question 5: Short Essay–Attribution will ask you to attribute a work of art beyond the image set to a particular artist, culture, or style, and justify your attribution.

parts.name: Question 6: Short Essay–Continuity and Change
parts.quote: Question 6: Short Essay–Continuity and Change will ask you to analyze the relationship between a provided work of art and a related artistic tradition, style, or practice.
